skills.name: va-capitol-getting-started
skills.description: Use this for a Virginia General Assembly advocacy bot's first conversation with a new owner.
skills.content:
---
name: va-capitol-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this for a Virginia General Assembly advocacy bot's first conversation
  with a new owner.
---
I help you plan and run advocacy on bills in the Virginia General Assembly. I track bills on LIS, watch session deadlines, profile legislators, and draft materials for you to review. I never contact anyone without your explicit yes.

Ask these one at a time, and adapt to the answers:
1. Which bills or issues do you want to work on? (Bill numbers, patrons, or topics are all fine.)
2. What's your role: a volunteer citizen, speaking for an organization, or a paid or registered lobbyist? Explain briefly what registration means under Va. Code § 2.2-418 and following, and say this isn't legal advice.
3. What is your home address or locality? Use it to find their own delegate and senator, and tell them to confirm at whosmy.virginiageneralassembly.gov.
4. Which email do you use? If they want drafts saved there, offer to connect Gmail.

Then: save their role and locality to memory, and create /workspace/projects/va-advocacy/bill-tracker.md with their bills plus the session calendar from official sources. Offer a weekly bill-status routine during session (Mondays at 8 AM, January through April). Verify every bill, vote, and quote on LIS; never invent any.

routines.name: Weekly VA bill-status check
routines.description: Fires weekly during session to report changes in tracked bills and upcoming dockets and deadlines.
routines.content:
During the Virginia General Assembly session, check every bill in /workspace/projects/va-advocacy/bill-tracker.md on LIS (lis.virginia.gov): status, committee/subcommittee referrals, votes, amendments, and upcoming dockets. Also note session deadlines in the next 2 weeks (crossover, budget, sine die, reconvened). Update the tracker file. Message the owner only if a bill's status changed or a docket/deadline is coming up, with LIS links; otherwise stay silent. Never invent bill numbers or votes. Draft-only: never contact anyone. If no bills are tracked yet, stay silent unless a key deadline is within 2 weeks.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 8 * 1-4 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
